video_caption: In this video segment, a woman with dark, curly hair styled in a high puff, wearing a grey patterned tank top over a black top, stands against a bright green chevron-patterned background. At 00:05, a red "Subscribe" button with a white play icon and white text appears in the bottom right corner of the screen, partially obscuring her right hand. She is looking at the camera, smiling, and appears to be speaking while gesturing with her right hand towards the "Subscribe" button. By 00:06, the "Subscribe" button disappears, and she brings both hands up, gesturing while continuing to smile and speak. Her expression shifts to a broader smile, and she winks her left eye at 00:08. She then resumes speaking and gesturing with both hands, maintaining eye contact with the camera.

In the video segment, a woman with dark, curly hair styled in a high bun is seated in front of a vibrant green and white chevron-patterned background. She is wearing a grey and white camouflage-patterned tank top over a black athletic top. From 0:00 to 0:01, she looks directly at the camera and speaks. At 0:01, she brings her hands together in a gesture resembling prayer or thoughtfulness, and white text appears prominently on the screen, reading: "WHAT YOU NEED FOR VOLLEYBALL TOURNAMENTS". (The text explains the topic of the video). This text remains visible until 0:05, and briefly around 0:04, a light pink rectangular shape passes downwards over her face, partially obscuring it.

A young woman with dark, curly hair styled in an updo and wearing a grey and white patterned tank top over a black top is speaking directly to the camera against a bright green chevron-patterned background. She smiles as text overlays the screen, reading "GRAB A PAPER AND PENCIL!". A colorful animated transition then displays the text "GRAB PAPER AND A PENCIL" in dark green letters, set against a white background with overlapping, moving abstract shapes in yellow, teal, and pink. The video then cuts back to the young woman, who is still smiling and raises her right hand to point her index finger upwards.

A Black woman with dark, curly hair pulled up, wearing a grey and white patterned tank top, is seated in front of a bright green and white zigzag patterned background. Initially, she gestures with her hands, and the pink text "ODRANT" is visible on the bottom left of the screen. From 0:02, she holds up a light blue stick of Secret deodorant in her right hand, while the text updates to "#1 - DEODRANT" in pink. She speaks directly to the camera, making various hand gestures, sometimes bringing her left hand to her mouth, emphasizing her points. At 0:07, additional pink text appears below the first line: "SWEAT PROCURES STINK! APPLY SOME DEODRANT BEFORE YOU PLAY!" She smiles broadly, looking directly at the camera, continuing to hold the deodorant and gesture. She appears cheerful and engaging throughout the segment.

A woman with dark curly hair and wearing a grey tank top with colorful bracelets on her left wrist stands against a bright green wall with a zig-zag pattern. From 0:00 to 0:14, she holds up a light green BlenderBottle water bottle, gesturing with her right hand as she speaks, then lowers the bottle. On the bottom left of the screen, the text "#2 - A WATER BOTTLE" appears, identifying the item. Further text overlays from 0:05 to 0:10 read, "YOU WANT TO BE ABLE TO FILL UP THE WATER BOTTLE AND NOT HAVE TO CONSTANTLY GO TO THE FOUNTAIN." (English: "YOU WANT TO BE ABLE TO FILL UP THE WATER BOTTLE AND NOT HAVE TO CONSTANTLY GO TO THE FOUNTAIN."), explaining the utility of the water bottle. From 0:14 to 0:34, she holds up a yellow Vaseline Spray & Go Moisturizer bottle. The text changes to "#3 - LOTION" on the bottom left of the screen. She then demonstrates spraying the lotion onto her outstretched left arm and rubbing it in, looking at the camera and smiling. Text overlays from 0:20 to 0:22 state, "GET A MOISTURIZING LOTION SO THAT YOUR SKIN DOES NOT GET DRY." (English: "GET A MOISTURIZING LOTION SO THAT YOUR SKIN DOES NOT GET DRY."). She continues to talk while holding up the lotion bottle.

The video opens with a woman, dressed in a grey and black patterned tank top, against a vibrant green chevron background. She holds up a yellow aerosol can of "Vaseline Spray & Go moisturizer" with her left hand, presenting it to the camera with a slight smile. She then looks directly at the camera, her expression becoming more engaging. As she smiles and points her finger, text appears at the bottom left: "#4- BRING EXTRA SOCKS!". She picks up a pair of small, rolled-up green and yellow socks and gestures with them while speaking, explaining their importance. More text appears, reading: "YOU NEVER KNOW WHEN YOU'RE GOING TO NEED THEM! KEEP THEM IN YOUR BAG!". She then holds the socks closer to the camera for a clearer view. Following this, she drops the socks and picks up a small, purple book, holding it in her right hand. Text appears on screen at the bottom right: "TO DO!" and below it, "#5- BRING SOMETHING TO DO!", implying the book is an example of such an item. She looks thoughtfully at the book and then smiles at the camera.

In this video segment, a Black woman with dark, curly hair tied up, wearing a grey and white patterned tank top over a black sports bra, is positioned against a vibrant green and white chevron-patterned background. At 00:01, she smiles slightly, looking up and to the right, then broadens her smile and gestures with her right hand as she speaks. A pink text overlay in the bottom left corner reads "#5- BRING SOMETHING TO DO!", indicating the video is presenting a list of tips. From 00:02, another text overlay appears at the bottom, stating, "YOU WILL HAVE DOWN TIME AT TOURNAMENTS BRING HOMEWORK, A BOOK, OR SOMETHING TO DO SO YOU WON'T GET BORED." (This text advises viewers to bring an activity to fill idle time during tournaments to prevent boredom). At 00:03, she holds up a book with a blue-grey cover and white text, showing the title "DON'T SWEAT THE SMALL STUFF... and it's all small stuff" (English text, suggesting a self-help book about not worrying about minor issues), then brings it closer to her chest while continuing to talk and smile.

In a video segment set against a bright green and white chevron patterned background, a woman with dark, curly hair pulled up in a bun and wearing a grey and white tank top, bracelets, and rings on her fingers, presents healthy snack options. Initially, a text overlay at the bottom reads "#6 - BRING SNACKS!!!!!!!!!" as she holds up a small orange in her left hand and a white-wrapped protein bar in her right. She then holds the orange closer to the camera, emphasizing it, as a new text block appears, stating, "YOU USUALLY GET A LUNCH PERIOD. HOWEVER YOU WON'T HAVE FOOD UNTIL THEN! IF YOU DONT LIKE FAST FOOD, BRING LUNCH!" She puts the orange down and holds up the protein bar, which is a "ThinkThin Protein Cakes" bar, showing it to the camera. Text overlays change to "MORE PROTEIN :)" then "EAT MORE PROTEIN :)" and "Subscribe" with a button. She turns the bar around to show the nutritional information, discussing its protein content (12 grams) and calorie count (170 calories), before the segment ends.

A smiling Black woman with dark, curly hair tied up, wearing a grey sleeveless top, stands against a bright green zig-zag patterned background. On-screen text reads "#7- BRING MONEY WITH YOU" (English). She introduces a tip, then displays a small, bright pink, rubbery coin purse with two spherical clasps at the top, explaining it's her "change purse" which she keeps dollar bills and change in for vending machines. Additional text appears, stating: "YOU MIGHT WANT TO BUY TOURNAMENT MERCH LUNCH DURING LUNCH TIME, OR A DRINK FROM THE SNACK MACHINE" (English), with "MERCH" briefly appearing separately. Later, the text updates to "YOU MIGHT WANT TO BUY TOURNAMENT MERCH LUNCH DURING LUNCH TIME, OR A DRINK FROM THE SNACK MACHINES" (English). She emphasizes the practicality of having change and dollar bills. The on-screen text then changes to "MAKE SURE TO BRING SOME $1 BILLS. THE SNACK MACHINES DON'T TAKE ANYTHING BIGGER THAN THAT." (English) as she continues to hold and gesture with the pink coin purse.

A Black woman with dark, curly hair tied up, wearing a grey and white patterned tank top, stands in front of a bright green and white chevron background. A pink stylized "M" is visible in the bottom left corner. She speaks to the camera, initially gesturing with her hands. At the 0:01 mark, she holds up a small, black rectangular pouch with a clear front pocket, revealing an item inside. Pink text appears at the bottom of the screen, stating: "#8 - BRING CHAPSTICK AND GUM". She briefly forms a peace sign with her right hand while holding the pouch. By 0:06, the on-screen text changes to: "I HATE CHAPPED LIPS AND COTTON MOUTH. THIS WILL HELP!", as she continues to gesture with the pouch and touch her chest and lips. She then puts the pouch down momentarily before retrieving a small, white chapstick tube from it. At 0:27, she holds up the chapstick tube with a bright smile, and the text on screen changes to: "SUGAR COOKIE CHAPSTICK!!!!". She twists the tube to display the "CHAPSTICK" brand name and indicates the "Sugar Cookie" flavor while still smiling and talking to the camera. She wears a white fitness tracker on her left wrist and several colorful bracelets on her right, with multi-colored nail polish.

In a brightly lit video segment, a Black woman with her dark, curly hair styled in a high bun stands before a vibrant green background adorned with a white zigzag pattern. She is wearing a grey and white patterned tank top over a black sports bra, along with a watch on her left wrist and colorful beaded bracelets on her right. At the 0:05 mark, text overlays the screen with "#8 - KEEP EXTRA HAIR BANDS" (English: "#8 - KEEP EXTRA HAIR BANDS"), as she holds up several black hair ties in both hands, then gestures with them as she speaks. At 0:10, additional text appears: "THIS IS ONE OF THE #1 THINGS WE NEED AND DON'T HAVE AT TOURNAMENTS." (English: "THIS IS ONE OF THE #1 THINGS WE NEED AND DON'T HAVE AT TOURNAMENTS."), reinforcing the importance of hair ties. She continues to hold and gesture with the hair ties, at one point pointing to her own hair, and then at 0:24, the text changes to "#SHARINGISCARING" (English: "#SHARINGISCARING") as she looks directly at the camera, implying a humorous or relatable sentiment about needing or sharing hair accessories.

In a video segment set against a vibrant green chevron-patterned background, a woman with dark, curly hair styled in a high puff, wearing a grey and white patterned tank top over a black top, appears. She has a pink watch on her left wrist and colorful bracelets on her right. At the beginning, she extends her arms forward, holding a small white cardboard package containing several black bobby pins horizontally, partially obscuring her face. Text overlays appear on the screen: "#9 - BRING BOBBY PINS!" (English: "Number 9 - Bring Bobby Pins!") and shortly after, "YOU NEED THEM TO KEEP YOUR HAIR UP, AND OUT OF YOUR FACE!" (English: "You need them to keep your hair up, and out of your face!"). She explains that she cut a strip of bobby pins in half for convenience. She then lowers her arms, looking directly at the camera as she speaks, emphasizing the necessity of multiple bobby pins. Towards the end of the clip, she briefly holds up the bobby pin package again with her right hand, then gestures near her head with her left hand as if tucking away flyaway hairs, reinforcing her point about keeping hair in place.

A smiling woman with dark curly hair tied up in a high bun, wearing a gray and white patterned tank top, a black bra strap visible, and colorful bracelets, stands in front of a bright green chevron-patterned wall. She holds up a small, white travel-sized bottle with a black cap, identified as Carol's Daughter Hair Milk, which she explains she uses for hair moisturizer to slick down edges and combat dryness, with overlay text initially stating "#10 - BRING HAIR CREAM OR HAIR SPRAY" (00:03) and then "BELIEVE ME, YOU TAKE PICTURES. LOL." (00:06). She gestures to her hair with her free hand while holding the bottle, demonstrating its purpose. After putting the bottle down, she then pulls out a small black zippered pouch, opening it to reveal lip products inside, and smiles as she mentions her love for lipsticks before the video abruptly cuts off with an error sound as she moves out of frame (00:29).

In the video segment, a woman with dark, curly hair and dark skin, wearing a grey camouflage tank top and colorful bracelets, stands against a bright green chevron-patterned background. At the beginning (0:03), she holds up a pair of pink, black, yellow, and blue sneakers with light blue laces, while on-screen text reads "#11 - BRING AN EXTRA PAIR OF SHOES." She then retrieves two small, colorful, spherical objects, identified as "shoe balls," and demonstrates placing one into each sneaker, explaining they prevent shoes from getting "stinky." Throughout this demonstration, she maintains a friendly and instructional expression. Around 0:20, a red "Subscribe" button appears in the bottom right corner of the screen. She continues to hold the shoes, emphasizing that volleyball shoes are only for indoor use, and concludes by stating the importance of wearing an additional pair of shoes, with the on-screen text "GIVE YOUR FEET SOME TIME TO REST" appearing at 0:30.

In this video segment, a woman with dark, curly hair styled in a high bun and wearing a grey and white patterned tank top is positioned against a vibrant green background with a prominent zigzag pattern. At 0:05, she holds a colorful sneaker with pink, blue, yellow, and black accents in her left hand, looking down at it with a slight smile. By 0:06, she looks directly at the camera, talking, and gestures with her open right palm as if explaining something. Subsequently, at 0:07, she brings a folded piece of grey fabric, possibly clothing, up towards her face, holding it with both hands and looking at it intently.

In the video segment, a Black woman with curly hair pulled up, wearing a grey and white patterned tank top over a black top, and sporting colorful bracelets and a white watch, speaks directly to the camera against a bright lime green and white chevron background. At the start, she holds up a grey jacket with white stripes in her left hand, talking animatedly, with the text "#12 - BRING A JACKET!" displayed in pink at the bottom left. She makes an "okay" gesture with her right hand, maintaining an enthusiastic expression while talking. From 00:04 to 00:06, the text "R CONDITIONING IS NO JOKE." appears in pink at the bottom right, changing to "THE AIR CONDITIONING IS NO JOKE." from 00:06 onwards, as she continues to explain her point with various hand gestures and a focused expression.

A young woman with dark curly hair, wearing a grey and white patterned tank top, stands in front of a bright green chevron-patterned background. She holds a coiled, light-colored phone charger, which she then unwinds, extending it to demonstrate its length while saying, "MOST LIKELY THE OUTLET IS GOING TO BE SOMEWHERE INCONVENIENT." (Meaning: It's unlikely you'll find a convenient power outlet, so a long charger is helpful.) She continues to hold the charger, looking directly at the camera, as text appears on the screen stating, "KEEP YOUR PHONE CHARGED PAST 50% AT ALL TIMES! SAFETY FIRST!" (Meaning: Always ensure your phone has sufficient battery charge for safety reasons.) Towards the end of the segment, she drops one end of the charger and looks down at the remaining part in her hands as new text appears: "#15 - BRING AN EXTRA SHIRT" (Meaning: This is tip number 15, and the advice is to pack an additional shirt.)

A dark-skinned woman with dark, curly hair styled in a high puff, wearing a grey and white patterned tank top over a black top, and colorful bracelets on her left wrist, stands before a vibrant green and white chevron-patterned background. She holds up a white t-shirt that reads "I CAN'T Adult TODAY MAYBE TOMORROW" in black, pink, and white lettering. An orange and white text overlay appears at the bottom of the screen, stating, "WHEN IT'S OVER, YOU'RE GOING TO WANT TO CHANGE OUT YOUR JERSEY." (This text implies the shirt is a replacement for a sweaty sports jersey after an activity.) She briefly lowers the shirt, folds it, and then holds it up again before fully folding it and looking directly at the camera with a friendly expression, gesturing with her hands as she speaks.

A woman with dark, curly hair in a high bun, wearing a gray and white patterned tank top over a black top, is centered in a medium shot against a bright green background with a white chevron pattern. She has a light pink wristband on her right wrist and several colorful beaded bracelets on her left. She is holding a clear plastic zipper bag containing small white items and a pink card in her left hand, and a small, light-colored roll of tape in her right hand, gesturing with both as she speaks. From 0:05 to 0:28, the text "DON'T WORRY, AN ATHLETIC TRAINER SHOULD BE ON STAFF." appears at the bottom of the screen. This text then changes to "EVEN SO, KEEP YOUR OWN STASH." at 0:28, and a moment later, it changes again to "#SHARINGBECARING". The woman then lowers her hands and looks down, ending the segment.

A woman with dark skin and curly black hair, wearing a grey tank top and a white wristband, is seated in front of a bright lime green wall with a white zigzag pattern. She speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with her hands. At 0:05, she holds up a small, round, light-colored compact to her ear, while the text "OUTLETS ARE TRICKY AT TOURNEYS." appears in pink on the lower left. She explains it's an external phone charger and then demonstrates that it also functions as a mirror, opening it to reveal a reflective surface and a light, emphasizing its dual purpose and usefulness when outlets are scarce.

A woman with dark, curly hair tied up in a bun, wearing a grey camouflage-patterned tank top over a black top, is seated in front of a bright green wall with a white zigzag pattern. At 0:02, the text "#18 - FEMININE PRODUCTS" appears in pink and white at the bottom left of the screen. She initially looks down and to her right, then turns to face the camera, speaking and gesturing with her hands. She holds a small, folded purple item, resembling a sanitary napkin or pantyliner. At 0:13, the text "MENSTRUAL CYCLES CAN SOMETIMES BE UNPREDICTABLE." appears in pink and white overlayed on the bottom of the screen. She continues to speak and gesture, looking directly at the camera, smiling at times. At 0:20, the text "A TEAM SUPPORTS EACH OTHER." appears in pink and white, replacing the previous text. She maintains eye contact with the camera, continuing her explanation and gesturing with her hands, holding the purple item.

The video opens with a Black woman with curly dark hair tied up, wearing a grey and white patterned tank top over a black sports bra, smiling and enthusiastically talking to the camera against a bright green zig-zag patterned background. She uses various hand gestures, including palms up, clasped hands, and a wave, as she speaks. At 00:17, a red YouTube "Subscribe" button with a white play icon appears in the bottom right corner of the screen, which then changes to a filled red rectangle with white text "SUBSCRIBED" (meaning the channel has been subscribed to) and a grey bell icon at 00:18. The scene transitions at 00:21 to an outdoor sports field on a sunny day with a blue sky. The same woman, now wearing a white t-shirt that says "I CAN'T ADULT TODAY MAYBE TOMORROW" (expressing a desire to avoid adult responsibilities for the day), is standing on a grassy area scattered with colorful volleyballs. A baseball field with red dirt, a chain-link fence, and trees are visible in the background. She holds a colorful volleyball, smiles, looks around, and then playfully bounces the ball on her hand before holding it again, as the camera slightly pans.
